parameters.subject: =Invoice {{ $('Prepare Approval Context').item.json.invoice_id }} - Received & Pending Approval
parameters.message:
={{ `

Hello ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.requester_name},

Your invoice ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.invoice_id} has been received and exceeds the auto-approve threshold of ₹${Number($('Evaluate Invoice Total').first().json.setting_value)}.

Invoice ID ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.invoice_id}
Amount ₹${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.amount}
Case ID ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.case_id || 'N/A'}
Status Pending Review (1-Min SLA)

An approval request has been dispatched to the designated approver. You will be notified automatically once decided or if it times out.

` }}

parameters.subject: ="ACTION REQUIRED [Stage 1 - Firm Administrator]: Invoice " + $('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.invoice_id + " - Approve or Decline"
parameters.message:
={{ `

An invoice exceeding the auto-approve threshold has been submitted that requires your approval as Firm Administrator:

Invoice ID ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.invoice_id}
Amount ₹${Number($('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
Case ID ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.case_id || 'N/A'}
Requester ${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.requester_name} (${$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.requester_role})
Stage Stage 1 (Firm Administrator Initial Review)

Please review the invoice details and select an action below:

` }}

values.placeholder: If declining, please enter the reason...

options.responseFormDescription: Please review the invoice details and select Approve or Decline. If declining, enter the reason below.

parameters.sendTo: ={{ [$('Prepare Approval Context').first().json.notify_email, $('Get Case Approvers').first().json.case_owner_email, $('Get Case Approvers').first().json.firm_admin_email].filter(Boolean).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).join(', ') }}
parameters.message:
={{ (() => { const ctx = $('Prepare Approval Context').first().json || {}; const approvers = $('Get Case Approvers').isExecuted ? ($('Get Case Approvers').first().json || {}) : {}; const invoiceId = ctx.invoice_id || 'INV-001'; const caseId = ctx.case_id || 'N/A'; const amountFormatted = Number(ctx.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); const requesterName = ctx.requester_name || approvers.client_name || 'Client'; const timestampStr = $now.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy, hh:mm a'); const isPending = $('Send Pending Notification').isExecuted; if (!isPending) { if (Number(ctx.amount) <= 0 || !ctx.amount) { return `
Legal Practice Management • Billing Service

⛔ Invoice Request Invalid

Reference: ${invoiceId} • Case #${caseId}

Hello ${requesterName},

Your invoice generation request could not be processed because the billed amount is invalid or zero.

Please verify matter billing details and submit again.

`; } const thresholdVal = Number($('Evaluate Invoice Total').first().json?.setting_value || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); return `
Legal Practice Management • Financial Division

⚡ Invoice Auto-Approved

Invoice Ref: ${invoiceId} • Case Reference: #${caseId}

Dear ${requesterName},

Your billing invoice has cleared firm verification rules and was Auto-Approved within the standard practice threshold (Limit: ₹${thresholdVal}).

Invoice ID:${invoiceId}
Case ID:Case #${caseId}
Billed Amount:₹${amountFormatted}
Status:AUTO-APPROVED
Decision Timestamp:${timestampStr}

Legal Practice Management System • Privileged & Confidential Financial Record

`; } const s1Declined = $('Evaluate Stage 1 Decision').isExecuted && (['decline', 'reject'].includes(($('Stage 1: Firm Admin Approval').first()?.json?.data?.Decision || '').toString().toLowerCase()) || $('Stage 1: Firm Admin Approval').first()?.json?.data?.approved === false); const s2Declined = $('Evaluate Stage 2 Decision').isExecuted && (['decline', 'reject'].includes(($('Stage 2: Client Approval').first()?.json?.data?.Decision || '').toString().toLowerCase()) || $('Stage 2: Client Approval').first()?.json?.data?.approved === false); const s2Approved = $('Evaluate Stage 2 Decision').isExecuted && (($('Stage 2: Client Approval').first()?.json?.data?.Decision || '').toString().toLowerCase() === 'approve' || $('Stage 2: Client Approval').first()?.json?.data?.approved === true); if (s1Declined || s2Declined) { const declinerRole = s1Declined ? 'Firm Administrator' : 'Client / Case Owner'; const reasonNote = s1Declined ? ($('Stage 1: Firm Admin Approval').first()?.json?.data?.['Rejection Reason / Notes'] || 'Declined during administrative review.') : ($('Stage 2: Client Approval').first()?.json?.data?.['Rejection Reason / Notes'] || 'Declined by client.'); return `
Legal Practice Management • Financial Division

⛔ Invoice Request Declined

Invoice Ref: ${invoiceId} • Case Reference: #${caseId}

Dear ${requesterName},

Your billing invoice for ₹${amountFormatted} has been declined during review by ${declinerRole}.

Invoice Reference:${invoiceId}
Decision:DECLINED
Declined By:${declinerRole}
Reason / Notes:${reasonNote}
Timestamp:${timestampStr}

If revisions or adjustments are required, please update matter billing parameters or resubmit through the practice portal.

Legal Practice Management System • Privileged & Confidential Financial Record

`; } if (s2Approved) { return `
Legal Practice Management • Financial Division

⚖️ Invoice Fully Approved

Official Invoice: ${invoiceId} • Case Reference: #${caseId}

Dear ${requesterName},

We are pleased to inform you that your billing invoice has successfully cleared all required stages of review and is now Fully Approved & Certified under practice compliance policies.

Invoice Reference: ${invoiceId}
Case Matter ID: Case #${caseId}
Total Invoiced Amount: ₹${amountFormatted}
Multi-Tier Status: ✅ Fully Approved
Tier 1 Authorization: ✓ Firm Administrator Sign-off Completed
Tier 2 Authorization: ✓ Client / Case Owner Sign-off Completed
Approval Timestamp: ${timestampStr}

Ledger Notice: This invoice transaction has been permanently recorded to the matter audit ledger. Certified digital PDF invoice documents and financial statements are available anytime on the legal services portal.

📱 Access Client Portal & View Receipts

Legal Practice Management System • Privileged & Confidential Financial Record

`; } return `
Legal Practice Management • Financial Division

⚠️ Approval Window Expired

Invoice Ref: ${invoiceId} • Case Reference: #${caseId}

Dear ${requesterName},

The designated approval window for Invoice ${invoiceId} (₹${amountFormatted}) has timed out without approver confirmation.

The matter billing transaction has been escalated for administrative resolution.

Legal Practice Management System • Privileged & Confidential Financial Record

`; })() }}
